# Kennedy Cheroben — Visual Design Specialist & Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio and professional profile of Kennedy Cheroben, based in Nairobi, Kenya.

## Summary
Kennedy Cheroben is a Visual Design Specialist and Full-Stack Developer specializing in custom PHP applications, relational database systems (MySQL/PDO), responsive frontends, and user-centered UI/UX design.

## Professional Capabilities & Services
- Full-Stack Web Applications: PHP 8+, PDO, MySQL, multipage and MVC architectures, custom admin dashboards, role-based authorization, secure authentication, and CSRF/XSS mitigation.
- Responsive Websites: Semantic HTML5, modern CSS, mobile-first layouts, accessible interaction patterns (WCAG 2.2 AA), and cross-browser refinement.
- UI/UX & Visual Design: Interface design, information architecture, wireframing, interactive prototyping in Figma, and design systems.
- Maintenance & Optimization: Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals performance, database indexing, code auditing, and accessibility remediation.

## Core Technology Stack
- Languages: PHP 8+, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, Python
- Databases: MySQL, MariaDB, PDO
- Design: Figma, Visual Design Systems, Interactive Prototyping
- Standards & Tooling: Technical SEO, WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility, REST APIs, Git, cPanel deployment
